# [native]
# x402Interop marketplace

> A directory of paid services for AI agents and people. Services are paid per request over x402, with payments settled on the buyer's chain and received on the seller's chain.

## Read the catalogue

- GET /discovery/resources?q=&network=&asset=&category=&owner=&maxPrice=&limit=&offset= on the facilitator (the URL is set at build time as PUBLIC_FACILITATOR_URL)
- GET /discovery/resources/{id} returns one listing
- GET /discovery/merchants lists owners and their networks and assets
- GET /marketplace/fees shows listing fees (currently free)

## Get a payment quote

- POST /interop/quote with sellerNetwork, sellerAsset, sellerAddress, amount (atomic units), buyerNetwork, buyerAsset, buyerAddress, and deliveryMode. The response holds a single-use deposit address and an expiry.

## Write (list, edit, delete, health check)

Writes are signed per action. Ask for a challenge with POST /auth/challenge ({family, address, method, path, bodyHash}), where family is evm, sui, or solana, and bodyHash is the SHA-256 hex of the exact JSON body (empty string for no body). Sign the returned message with the wallet, then send the request with header x-x402interop-signature: {"nonce": "...", "signature": "..."}. Each challenge is single-use and expires after five minutes.

## Pages

- / search the catalogue
- /service?id={id} a listing
- /quote mint a deposit quote
- /register list a service (wallet required)
- /listings your listings (wallet required)
- /terms and /privacy (drafts pending legal review)
